name: Maur Grimtotem
summary: Deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, Maur Grimtotem lies dead. Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent him to seek peace with the troggs, and his remains and satchel are still in the caverns.

sections.title: A Doomed Diplomacy
sections.body: Maur Grimtotem went into Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar as an envoy to the troggs. Most of the Horde saw them as savage brutes beyond negotiation, but Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem thought peace might be possible, or at least said so. Maur carried her offer into the winding caverns. The troggs killed him, and his body remains under the watch of their chieftain, Oggleflint.

sections.title: The Elder Crone's Interests
sections.body: After Maur's death, Magatha sought adventurers to retrieve the satchel he carried into the caverns, as well as avenge him. Whether Maur believed peace with the troggs could be reached remains unknown. Those who find his belongings may still wonder whether Magatha sent him as a true envoy or as a pawn in her schemes.

faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem was a tauren of the Grimtotem clan. Magatha Grimtotem sent him as an emissary to the troggs in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, where they killed him.

faq.q: Why did he try to negotiate with troggs?
faq.answer: Elder Crone Magatha claimed she sent Maur to seek peace and test the strength of the subterranean foes. Whether she had another motive remains an open question.
The troggs of Ragefire Chasm killed Maur. Their chieftain, Oggleflint, guarded his body.

faq.q: What happened to his body and belongings?
faq.answer: Maur's body remains in Ragefire Chasm near Oggleflint. Rahauro in Thunder Bluff sends adventurers to recover Maur's lost satchel and bring it to him on the Elder Rise for Magatha Grimtotem.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the Grimtotem clan has an uneasy relationship with the other tribes in Thunder Bluff. Maur's fatal errand into the trogg tunnels deepens suspicion of Magatha's agenda.
As a member of the Horde, you face the danger of a deadly cavern beneath Orgrimmar. Sending envoys alone to negotiate with troggs ended in disaster.
